title: Project fixed-values registry
description: Values that differ per project and must not overlap. Sync does not overwrite them. Ports follow the portScheme formula in registry/platform.json (base + slot).

localTools.description: Local tools that are not apps (no deploy, DB, or sync) but hold a slot so their ports never collide with an app. They list only the ports they use; each follows the same formula (ADR-0006, #435).

sharedServices.description: Services every app uses, such as the shared sign-in (ADR-0015). Not apps: not counted among the 8 apps and not synced as one. They share the slot sequence and port formula with apps (ADR-0006) and may use a reserved subdomain.

slot.description: Shares the slot sequence with projects. Never reassigned
Shares the slot sequence with projects. Never reassigned

subdomain.description: One DNS label under rootDomain. Reserved names are allowed here

title.description: Name used in the deploy unit descriptions (#696)

name.description: The database name; the deploy files keep dumps in /var/backups/<name> (#696)

ghcr.description: CI-built images in GHCR (ADR-0023). Both default to false when the field is missing. Turn push on first and let one run on main finish; turn pull on after that. A pull that fails still falls back to the local build (#754, #755, #757)

push.description: The CI pushes the images for each commit on main to ghcr.io (needs packages: write in the caller; the private package budget, #756)

pull.description: The server pulls the CI image for the commit instead of building it

nullableHost.description: null if undecided. Fill in only the value once decided.

title.description: Name used in docs and instructions (e.g. Study Log)

displayName.description: App display name used in the screen header, tab title, and PWA name. Apps are told apart only by this name, so it must not overlap (ADR-0008)

domain.description: Description of the service area (e.g. exercise)

summary.description: Service description used in the first paragraph of AGENTS.md

tagline.description: One user-facing sentence (at most 120 characters) about what the app does: the PWA manifest description shown in install dialogs and app stores. No internal notes such as users, login, or exposure rules (#594)

public.description: The umbrella repo is public. A public repo cannot call reusable workflows in the private central repo, so the shared CI is expanded inline in ci.yml (#209)

domain.description: Parent domain of this app's address. null uses rootDomain in platform.json (ADR-0012)

subdomain.description: One DNS label. Must equal name (ADR-0012). The address is <subdomain>.<domain or rootDomain>

apiBodyMb.description: Largest request body in MB that the web server passes to /api/ (nginx client_max_body_size). Optional, default 1 (the nginx default). Set it a little above the API's own upload limit so the API answers with its own 413 (#589)

prefix.description: AWS resource name prefix. null if undecided

e2e.description: Uses Playwright browser tests. Turns on the CI e2e job and the playwright.config.ts template (templates/e2e) (#33)

e2eVisual.description: Runs e2e in a Playwright container pinned by digest (versions.json images.playwright) with E2E_VISUAL=1 and compares screenshots. Turn on only when e2e and the db:migrate runner exist (#203)

contract.description: Uses the shared input contract shared/contract.ts with its two copies and `npm run contract:sync` (ADR-0026). Off for new apps: the scaffold writes the contract files only when this is on. Turn on when routes and screens share an enum or schema

ui.description: Syncs the shared UI components (templates/ui). Turn on after installing dependencies such as radix-ui in the app (#123, #126)

vitest.description: Syncs the component test setup frontend/vitest.config.ts (templates/vitest). Turn on after installing vitest, jsdom, and Testing Library (#33)

devcontainer.description: Syncs the Dev Container setup for a new PC (.devcontainer/, templates/devcontainer). Node uses versions.json images.devcontainerNode, and the DB uses the db service in the app's compose.yaml (#282)

lighthouse.description: Measures the frontend built in CI (frontend/dist) with Lighthouse CI and only warns on a missed threshold. Syncs lighthouserc.json (templates/lighthouse). Turn on after installing @lhci/cli at the app root (#280)

msw.description: Component tests run without a backend, using MSW mocks of the OpenAPI contract (docs/openapi.json). Syncs frontend/src/test/contract-api.ts (templates/msw). Turn on when openapi and vitest are on and msw is installed in frontend (#281)

query.description: The app uses @tanstack/react-query (ADR-0027). Syncs the shared query layer frontend/src/lib/query.ts (templates/query). Turn on in the adoption PR, after @tanstack/react-query is installed in frontend (#788)

knipStrict.description: The CI knip step fails if it reports anything. When off, it only warns. Turn on only for apps whose npm run knip result is 0 (#342)

darkOnly.description: The app uses dark mode only. It renders dark from the first paint, hides the theme menu, and uses a dark background for PWA colors. When off, users choose light, dark, or system (ADR-0011, #354)

jobs.description: Background jobs on pg-boss in the app's own Postgres, worked inside the api process (ADR-0018). Syncs backend/src/standard/jobs.ts (templates/jobs). The file imports only types, so it can be turned on before the app PR that installs pg-boss in backend (#556)

aiShell.description: Show the AI shell button in the top bar (ADR-0017, #612). Rendered into frontend/src/lib/ai-config.ts. Turn on per app only after shared-ai serves /api/chat

claude.description: The backend uses the Claude API. The deploy script reads ANTHROPIC_API_KEY from AWS SSM and passes it on, and the central command tools/app-secrets.mjs puts it in the local .env (ADR-0010, #265)
